suppress.notes: False positive: jackrabbit-spi-*.jar The generic cpe:apache:jackrabbit matches every Jackrabbit artifact. CVE-2026-92414 affects jackrabbit-jcr-server and CVE-2026-92415 affects jackrabbit-spi2dav, and this project depends on neither. jackrabbit-spi comes through jackrabbit-spi-commons, used only to generate the TypeScript declarations, and no bundle embeds it.
